spec.description: Dashboard for Smart Plant Dashboard Group Assignment MTI

spec.title: Historical Suhu
spec.description: Graph showing temperature data recorded using DHT22 from ESP32 board.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Water Level
spec.description: Graph showing humidity data recorded using BH1750 from ESP32 board.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_level")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mist_state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_state")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mist_state")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fan_state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fan_state")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "led_state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "led_state")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "moisture_forecast" and
    r._field == "predicted_moisture" and
    r.device == "esp32-01"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["device", "horizon", "model"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device", "horizon", "model"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.horizon == "10m")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "smart_plant" and
    r._field == "moisture" and
    r.device == "esp32-01"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: 1m,
    fn: mean,
    createEmpty: false,
    timeSrc: "_stop"
  )
  |> yield(name: "actual_moisture")

from(bucket: "SmartPlantIoT")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r._measurement == "moisture_policy_decision" and
        r.device == "esp32-01" and r.stage == "policy"
    )
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "model", "horizon", "decision", "reason_code",
        "explanation", "current_moisture", "predicted_moisture", "threshold",
        "upper_moisture_limit", "origin_epoch_ms", "target_epoch_ms"])
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> yield(name: "policy_history")
